title: 버스 탈 때, 아플 때: -(으)ㄹ 때로 '언제' 말하기
objective: By the end, you can attach -(으)ㄹ 때 to verbs and adjectives, including ㄹ-stems and ㅂ-adjectives, to say when something happens. You can also choose between 갈 때 and 갔을 때 correctly.
summary: Learn to say when something happens using -(으)ㄹ 때, and use -았/었을 때 for something that was already finished.

task.title: Use -(으)ㄹ 때
task.line: Change, choose, or join the words with -(으)ㄹ 때 or -았/었을 때.

forms.when: The stem ends in a vowel (타다, 가다, 보다).
forms.exampleMeaning: When I get on the bus, I tap my transit card.

forms.when: The stem ends in a consonant (먹다, 읽다, 앉다).
forms.exampleMeaning: I watch TV while I eat.

forms.when: The stem ends in ㄹ (만들다, 살다, 열다). Just add 때. Do not add 을.
forms.exampleMeaning: You need milk when you make bread.

forms.when: Adjectives follow the same rules. Use them to talk about a state.
forms.exampleMeaning: Take this medicine when you are sick.

forms.when: The action was already finished, or the state was true in the past.
forms.example: 한국에 처음 왔을 때 한국어를 잘 못했어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: When I first came to Korea, I couldn't speak Korean well.

watchOut: 먹을때 (X) → 먹을 때 (O): 때 is a separate word. Always put a space before it.
만들을 때 (X) → 만들 때 (O): If the stem ends in ㄹ, add only 때.
춥을 때 (X) → 추울 때 (O): Most adjectives ending in ㅂ change ㅂ to 우 (쉽다 → 쉬울 때).
회사에 갔을 때 지하철을 탔어요 (X) → 회사에 갈 때 지하철을 탔어요 (O): Use 갈 때 for 'on the way' and 갔을 때 for 'after you got there'. Put the past tense at the end of the sentence.
exercises: Fill in the blank with 씻다: 손을 ____ 때 비누를 꼭 쓰세요.
Fill in the blank with 만나다: 친구를 ____ 때 보통 카페에 가요.
Fill in the blank with 놀다: 아이들이 공원에서 ____ 때 저는 벤치에서 책을 읽어요.
Choose the correct form: 날씨가 (더울 때 / 덥을 때) 아이스커피를 자주 마셔요.
Write 갈 때 or 갔을 때: ① 고향에 ____ 비행기에서 잠을 잤어요. ② 고향에 ____ 가족들이 정말 좋아했어요.
Join the two parts into one sentence with -(으)ㄹ 때: 비가 오다 + 우산을 써요.
answers: ① 갈 때 ② 갔을 때
